# atproto_tangled_knot (Resource)

Registers a knot with Tangled. The appview verifies the registration by asking the knot for its owner, so the knot must be reachable over HTTPS and configured with this account as its owner.

Manages a `sh.tangled.knot` record.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "atproto_tangled_knot" "home" {
  domain = "knot.example.com"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain` (String) Domain the knot serves, such as `knot.example.com`. It is the record key.

### Optional

- `created_at` (String) Record creation time. Defaults to the time the record is created.

### Read-Only

- `cid` (String) CID of the current version of the record.
- `id` (String) AT URI of the record.
- `rkey` (String) Record key.
- `uri` (String) AT URI of the record.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
tofu import atproto_tangled_knot.home knot.example.com
```
